(Contract Issued) case → Overview tab shows btn-forms-pdf + btn-pack-pdf + btn-ai-duplicate-scan; AI duplicate scan click → ai-duplicate-result rendered; Contract tab shows btn-ai-consistency + btn-contract-pdf; AI consistency click → ai-consistency-result rendered with 'Risk: low' pill + plain-English summary ('No inconsistencies detected between the offer letter and employment contract...'); DBS/RTW tab shows new rtw-provider select (populated 'GOV.UK — View a job applicant's right to work'), rtw-provider-ref ('REF-RTW-4c6ebf'), dbs-provider ('DBS umbrella body'), dbs-provider-ref — saved values round-trip. Offer tab btn-offer-pdf present. No JS errors beyond the pre-existing CSP-blocked emergent-main.js / posthog / cloudflareinsights environmental noise.
critical_code_review_comments: verification_webhook: when APP_ENV is not set (dev/preview), _verify_webhook_sig() returns True regardless of whether an X-Onboarding-Signature header is present. This is deliberate per the acceptance criteria (webhook_secured=false today) but the hardening TODO is to require ONBOARDING_WEBHOOK_SECRET before going to production. Consider logging a WARN when accepting an unsigned webhook in non-production so it's discoverable in staging.

verification_webhook uses only provider_reference + provider to match. If two organisations happen to reuse the same provider_reference (unlikely but possible for the 'manual' provider), it could cross-match. Consider adding an org scoping hint (e.g. include organization_id in the initiate call and echo it back) before enabling real provider webhooks.

_ai_json falls back to slicing on the outermost { and } which may still fail for arrays. For duplicate-scan (root is object) it's fine; for future array-root responses, prefer a more explicit JSON extractor. Low priority.

ai_consistency 400 message is 'Create an offer and/or contract first' but current guard checks `offer.get('rendered') and contract.get('rendered')` — an issued offer without contract passes; matches spec (offer OR contract), but the error text says 'offer and/or contract'. Fine, but a subtle naming.
Prior iteration flag still stands: CaseWizard.Field defined inside render → focus loss per keystroke for real users (not touched in this backlog). Hoist to module scope.
